sensors.name: Server unit tests
sensors.description: Jest specs under apps/server/src (*.spec.ts). DB-gated specs skip silently without DATABASE_URL.

sensors.name: Client unit tests
sensors.description: Vitest tests under apps/client/src (*.test.ts/tsx), jsdom environment.

sensors.name: Monorepo build
sensors.description: nx run-many -t build across apps and packages. The client target runs tsc, so this is also the type-check gate.

sensors.name: Server lint
sensors.description: ESLint 9 flat config with --fix over apps/server. Note: no-explicit-any, no-unused-vars and ban-ts-comment are disabled, so this does not catch any-creep or dead code.

sensors.name: Server e2e smoke test
sensors.description: Nest bootstrap smoke test (apps/server/test/app.e2e-spec.ts) via supertest. Needs reachable Postgres and Redis; disabled by default because it is environment-dependent.

sensors.name: Kysely type drift check
sensors.description: Regenerates apps/server/src/database/types/db.d.ts from the live schema and fails if it differs from the committed file. Requires DATABASE_URL from the repo-root .env and a database migrated to latest. Enable when working on migrations.
sensors.command: pnpm --filter server migration:codegen && git diff --exit-code -- apps/server/src/database/types/db.d.ts

sensors.name: Security guardrail specs
sensors.description: Focused run of the specs protecting the security chokepoints: outbound URL guard and network policy, security headers, JWT auth guard, encryption service, no-urls validator. Use during security review.

sensors.name: Base formula benchmark
sensors.description: Runs packages/base-formula/bench/formula-bench.ts to detect tokenizer/parser/evaluator regressions. Enable only when changing the formula engine.

sensors.name: Container build parity
sensors.description: Builds the production image the way the Dockerfile does (single-threaded, 3 GB heap) to catch buildkit OOM and missing runtime artifacts. Enable for changes to the Dockerfile, workspace layout, or dependency graph.
